title: feat(mobile, app-shell): open the mobile shell's native connection switcher from the header organization button
body:
domain:ui#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jQjvWkZ7is6GXbC6DB

_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbNevw71SCDMBexHiueLgSVt)_
Fixes #29458

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:手机 App(原生壳)里点顶栏的组织按钮,现在打开 App 自带的「切换组织」面板,而不是网页下拉菜单;在 App 里只属于一个组织的用户也能看到这个按钮(只读的组织名标记随之让位,顶栏只显示一次组织);用户在 App 里移除某个连接时,Console 会及时应答,不再让 App 干等 10 秒。
- **为什么改**:原生面板能同时列出已保存的组织和公司服务器,网页菜单看不到这些;此前它只能从离线页打开。移除连接的应答是推送令牌注销的接口位,等设备注册(#29042)落地后在这里填上注销动作。
- **风险与回滚**:只在 App 声明了该能力时生效,普通浏览器和旧版 App 行为不变;回滚即还原本 PR,无数据与服务端改动。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/WorkspaceSwitcher.tsx`(按钮分支,位于单组织判断之前)、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/CurrentOrganizationIndicator.tsx`(App 内让位)、`ui/packages/mobile/src/useNativeHost.ts`(connectionRemoved 应答)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/WorkspaceSwitcher.nativeConnectionSwitcher.test.tsx packages/mobile/src/__tests__/nativeHost.test.tsx`,应全部通过(7 + 64)。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

The bridge contract is the mobile repository's `docs/HYBRID-SHELL.md` (objectstack-ai/mobile#173, merged at `678fbe9`). This session cannot read that repository, so the contract below is taken from the card's quoted text:

> **`window.ObjectStackNative.showConnectionSwitcher()`**, feature-detected with `has('showConnectionSwitcher')`. It opens the native 切换组织 sheet: the saved organizations and company servers, plus an add action.

> **`objectstack-native:connectionRemoved`**, a window event the shell sends to a loaded Console when the user removes its connection. The Console should: 1. call `event.waitUntil(promise)`; 2. unregister this device's push token with its own session, by the existing device-registry unregister path; 3. resolve. […] If the Console does not answer within 10 s, the shell records the token as left registered.

**The header organization button is `WorkspaceSwitcher`** (`data-testid="workspace-switcher"`), which `AppHeader` draws at every width (the badge alone below `sm`). `CurrentOrganizationIndicator` draws no control by design, and `OrgBadge` is only the mark, so neither is the button.

- `WorkspaceSwitcher`: when `nativeHostCan(useNativeHost(), 'showConnectionSwitcher')`, the trigger is a plain button that calls `nativeShowConnectionSwitcher()` and no dropdown is mounted. In the shell, with the capability, the button renders whenever there is an active organization, at any membership count: the native branch sits after the no-active-organization guard and before the single-membership guard. `orgList` counts this server's memberships only, while the sheet lists the shell's saved connections across company servers, so a user with one organization on each of two servers has two connections. Without the capability (plain browser, older shell) every rule is unchanged, the single-membership guard included. A `failed` answer from the shell is logged at `warn`.
- `CurrentOrganizationIndicator` renders nothing when the shell announces the capability, so a walled deployment at one membership draws the organization once, on the native button. The name shows at the same widths the indicator showed it (badge always, name from `sm` up, the same `hidden truncate sm:inline` span); a test pins that equality.
- **Why the button renders at one membership.** The seat chose this (option B) over option A in the first report ("leave as is (card scope)"), on review of this PR: the card's beneficiary is "a phone user with several organizations or company servers, who switches with one tap from the header", and single-organization users are the majority of them.
- `useNativeHostRouting` (already mounted by the Console's `NativeShellRouting`) listens for `objectstack-native:connectionRemoved` while the bridge is present and calls `event.waitUntil()` with the promise its new optional `onConnectionRemoved` returns. When the option is omitted, as the Console does today, the promise is already resolved. The latest handler is read through a ref, so the listener is installed once per bridge.
- `@object-ui/app-shell` now depends on `@object-ui/mobile` (which depends only on `@object-ui/types`; no cycle). Vitest and the Console's Vite config already alias `@object-ui/mobile` to `src`.

**Which unregister case holds: no registration exists, so there is nothing to unregister.** No Console path registers a device: the client SDK's device methods were removed (its `notifications` namespace comment says the `/notifications/devices` routes were never built), the server routes are #29041 (`pm:blocked`), and the registration card is #29042 (`pm:blocked`). So the Console has no token and no device id. The handler answers `waitUntil` with a resolved promise, and `onConnectionRemoved` is the seam where #29042 adds the unregister call. No registration is invented here.

**Widening (`@object-ui/mobile`, all new exports):**

- `'showConnectionSwitcher'` joins `NativeHostMethod`, and `showConnectionSwitcher?(): Promise<null>` joins `ObjectStackNative` as an optional method, the way `scan?` is: an older shell does not carry it.
- `nativeShowConnectionSwitcher()`: the typed wrapper, same `unavailable | ok | failed` answer as the others.
- `nativeHostCan(host, method)`: new export. It is the wrappers' own feature-detect (the former private `callable`), so a control can pick its native or web path before it renders.
- `NATIVE_CONNECTION_REMOVED_EVENT` and the `NativeConnectionRemovedEvent` type.
- `UseNativeHostRoutingOptions.onConnectionRemoved`.

No server change, no metadata key, no new i18n key.

## Tests

- New `WorkspaceSwitcher.nativeConnectionSwitcher.test.tsx` (7 cases, real Radix dropdown and a real click).
  - Two memberships: a fake host with the capability makes the button call `showConnectionSwitcher` once, with no `menu` role, no organization row and nothing switched. Two controls, with no host and with a host without the capability: the web menu opens with its rows and `showConnectionSwitcher` is never called.
  - One membership on a walled (`isolated`) deployment, `WorkspaceSwitcher` and `CurrentOrganizationIndicator` rendered side by side as `AppHeader` draws them. With the capability, the native button renders and opens the sheet, the indicator is absent, and the organization name is drawn once. The native button's name span carries the same classes as the indicator's. Two controls, with no host and with a host without the capability: no switcher and the read-only indicator, as today.
- `nativeHost.test.tsx` extended: `showConnectionSwitcher` joins the unavailable / missing-method / ok wrapper rows; `nativeHostCan` cases; a `connectionRemoved` block. With no unregister step, `waitUntil` gets a promise that resolves at once. With one, the shell is held until the step settles and the step runs once. The latest handler runs without a second listener. An event without `waitUntil` is left alone. Outside shell mode no listener is installed. The listener is removed on unmount.

## Acceptance notes

- **No unsaved-edits prompt before the native sheet opens.** Opening the sheet leaves nothing; the switch itself happens in the shell, which the page does not see.
